notes: Synthetic case, no real patient data. WHAT THIS TESTS: the § 5 Abs. 2 factor ladder at its upper end, and that the Höchstsatz is a per-band ceiling rather than a global 3.5. Three documented justifications of different severity land on three different rungs: 'schwer' on the shoulder puncture takes Nr. 302 to the Höchstsatz 3.5 of the general band, 'mittel' on the complete examination takes Nr. 7 to 2.3 + 0.3 = 2.6, and 'schwer' on the CRP takes Nr. 3741 to 1.3 — the Höchstsatz of the § 5 Abs. 4 laboratory band, NOT 3.5. EXPECTED BEHAVIOUR: a factor at the legal maximum with a written reason is accepted and capped, never rejected; a line without a justification (Nr. 3, Nr. 410, Nr. 3550) stays at its Schwellenwert.
